This is my main yam plot, so I must look after it well. I managed to get three bags of subsidized NPK 20-10-10 from the agro-dealer to help the tubers grow big, which I will spread across the land. I kept good yam setts from last season's harvest, so I will not waste money searching for improved seed that is hard to find around here. I will hire some young men for about thirty days to help with the heavy mounding and staking because my old body cannot manage that work alone, but my family and I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves when the rains come.
